capabilities: chat with an AI assistant that reads, searches, creates, and edits vault notes
approve or reject AI write operations with diff previews and rollback checkpoints
run workflows, hooks, and event-driven circuits from vault notes and schedules
connect MCP tool servers and author custom tools as Markdown files
maintain persistent memory as standard vault notes
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.11.4+); install is recommended via BRAT as a beta plugin; the Circuits feature is gated behind a toggle and off by default; full setup docs live in the repository's docs/ directory; manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, so using an LLM to safely read and modify vault notes requires a third-party plugin.

relations.evidence: run circuits, workflows, and tools from Templater scripts and other plugins

requires.name: LLM provider credentials (Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock, or search APIs)
a running LLM provider (local Ollama/LM Studio or cloud)

summary: Vault-aware AI chat assistant that reads, searches, creates, and edits notes with approval gates, checkpoints, memory, workflows, and MCP tool support.
